meta.title: ZIP3 local labor cost multipliers
meta.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2023 — construction laborers (SOC 47-2061)
meta.method: Tier 1: BLS OEWS May 2023 metro mean hourly wages for construction laborers, ratioed to the $23.69 national mean (16 major metros). Tier 2: BLS OEWS May 2023 state mean wages, ratioed to national (14 states). Tier 3: state planning estimates calibrated from BLS Current Employment Statistics (CES) state construction earnings relativities anchored to OEWS-verified states. Rounded to 2 decimals, clamped 0.80-1.40. Planning estimates only.
meta.zip3_source: GeoNames US ZIP dataset (majority state per ZIP3)
